title: Configure the pinned Anth.us newsroom pod
description:
# Configure the pinned Anth.us newsroom pod

## Purpose

Establish the smallest Kanbus project configuration that can own the Slice 1 story lifecycle without changing Kanbus core.

## Deliverables

- Pin a released Kanbus version.
- Define the newsroom story type and initial stage.
- Define forward transitions from idea through publication plus only the revision paths required by Slice 1.
- Establish the deterministic mapping from a stable Kanbus story identity to its owned file workspace.
- Define the expected idea, assignment, research, report, and article artifacts.
- Keep publication-specific configuration separate from generic Kanbus behavior.

## Implements

- PPY-d3e179: stable story workspace.
- PPY-7625aa: supported revision paths.

## Verification

The executable initialization and lifecycle specifications pass while Papyrus and Kanbus core remain unchanged.
